fields.summary_ko.0: Fortinet (FTNT) plunged 22% despite third annual full-year guidance raise, hitting approximately five-month low.
fields.summary_ko.1: FTNT's Q3 product revenue grew 37%, total revenue grew 20%, but core service revenue grew only 13% with annual service revenue guidance slightly lowered.
fields.summary_ko.2: FTNT maintains 29% annual billings increase ($2.3 billion) and 20% revenue growth forecast while raising annual earnings guidance and expanding share repurchase program by $1.2 billion.
